assumptions: Frozen lpips_squeeze_full.onnx has 526913088 convolution MACs per pair at 224x224 (57 Conv nodes), already reflected in trunk_conv. The former 1311618048 text was copied from AlexNet; the MAC coefficient itself needed no change. Existing pointwise approximation is retained pending a complete reduction-aware recount.
conv MAC/px is resolution-invariant for the stride-1 stack; edge padding ignored
oracle gate: lpips_vgg_trunk.onnx at 224^2 = 15,346,630,656 MACs vs published ~15.3 GMAC

The exported *_full.onnx graph takes both r and d and its counted operations already cover the pair. Graph stages use images=1; RGB ingress still uses images=2. Audited against frozen exported graphs on 2026-10-18; no runtime timing or counter equality is assumed.

Graph operation densities retain the original 224x224 reference-shape extrapolation. This correction removes the extra pair multiplier; it does not establish exact dynamic-shape, reduction, halo or traffic counts.
